purpose: Test the same bounded command-to-motion discrepancy with a different outcome: measured response recovers and navigation succeeds after a transient evaluator-owned mobility interruption.

run.expected_broad_outcome: successful navigation after a transient supported command-to-motion discrepancy and subsequent measured-response recovery

question: What temporarily prevented continued progress, what changed before the successful outcome, and what physical cause remains unresolved?
robot_visible_evidence: exact Nav2 parameters and BT XML
evaluator_only: whether a mobility hold/release was configured

admission.recording_valid: goal accepted; command and odometry streams retained; runtime/source hashes match; evaluator truth remains physically separate
admission.transient_discrepancy: the frozen development computation identifies at least one qualifying command-to-motion discrepancy interval before measured motion recovers
admission.measured_response_recovery: a later aligned window retains nonzero commands and independently measured planar response above the frozen development response threshold
admission.successful_outcome: NavigateToPose returns succeeded before the client deadline

allowed_diagnosis: A recorded interval had sustained commanded motion without the calibrated measured response; later measured response recovered and navigation succeeded.
withhold: a unique physical cause for either the discrepancy or recovery
claims that Nav2 consumed the retained odometry samples

analysis.threshold_policy: reuse the already selected development command-motion thresholds without tuning from this run
analysis.statistical_status: one new development scenario cluster if recording and induction gates pass; never pooled with the frozen legacy study
